motions.description: Approve the minutes of the January 9, 2024 regular meeting.

Approve the payment of payroll checks for department numbers 01 through 04, and accounts payable check numbers 23647 through 23688, in the total amount of $148,997.37, which includes payroll through January 19, 2024.
Approve the financial statements for January 9, 2024, subject to audit.
Approve the quote from ColorPro Painters / Don Schuetz Contracting of $3,840 for painting in the Great Room to cover water damage resulting from a masonry leak.
Approve the 2023 Illinois Public Library Report (IPLAR) report with the noted edits / updates.
Approve the proposed change to the Library's summer hours of closing one hour earlier on Mondays, Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays.
